sql: CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW logistics WITH CONTAINER kola AS SELECT r.month AS month, r.city AS city, r.carrier AS carrier, CAST(r.deliveries_scheduled AS BIGINT) AS deliveries_scheduled, CAST(r.deliveries_late AS BIGINT) AS deliveries_late, CAST(r.avg_delay_hours AS DOUBLE) AS avg_delay_hours FROM kola_systems.logistics_src LATERAL VIEW explode(records) AS r
